name: console
description: Runs your organization's Amplify security detections against code Claude commits, and feeds findings back into the session for Claude to fix or triage.

api_key.title: Amplify API key
api_key.description: API key issued by Amplify. Sent as a bearer token.

org_id.title: Amplify organization ID
org_id.description: Leave blank if your API key belongs to exactly one organization; it is detected automatically. Otherwise the plugin lists your organizations and asks you to pick one.

api_url.title: Amplify API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the Amplify API. Leave the default unless Amplify told you otherwise.

tenant_url.title: Amplify tenant service URL
tenant_url.description: Base URL of the Amplify account service, used only to list your organizations when org_id is blank. Leave the default unless Amplify told you otherwise.

cadence.title: Check cadence
cadence.description: When to run detections. Only "commit" is supported today.
